name: VaultGuard
tag: A secure client portal that keeps each client's files separate, sends agreements for signature and requires strong sign-in.

scenarios.title: Onboard a new client
scenarios.ask: Set up a portal space for a new client with {docs} intake documents and {signers} people who need to sign.
steps: Space builder
Created a private client space. Only this client and your assigned staff can see it.
Agreement agent
Filled the engagement letter from your template and sent it to {signers} signers in order.
Request list
Asked the client for {docs} documents with a checklist and due dates.
Access guard
Required {signin} sign-in for every client user before first upload.

result.title: Client space ready
rows: About {=3 + signers} minutes instead of {=20 + docs * 2}

followups: Can one client ever see another's files?
Each client space is separated at the storage level, and every file access is logged. Staff only see the clients they're assigned to.
What if a client struggles with sign-in?
They can use an email code to start, and you can require a stronger method for sensitive spaces later.

scenarios.title: Annual agreement renewals
scenarios.ask: {clients} client agreements renew this quarter. Send them out and chase the stragglers.
steps: Renewal agent
Prepared {clients} renewals with updated fees and dates from your fee schedule.
Sender
Sent them in batches through the portal with a signing link.
Follow-up
Scheduled reminders at day 5 and day 10. About {=round(clients * (100 - response) / 100)} clients are expected to need them.
Tracker
Shows signed, viewed and not opened, so staff only call those who haven't looked.
followups: Can clients sign on a phone?
Yes. Signing works on phone, tablet or computer, and the signed copy files itself in their space.
Can we change the fee for one client?
Yes. Edit that renewal before it sends and the change is recorded with your name.

scenarios.title: Sign-in security check
scenarios.ask: Check our portal's {users} users. We think about {weak}% still use weak sign-in.
steps: Auditor
Listed {users} users and how each signs in.
Risk scorer
Flagged {=round(users * weak / 100)} on email code only. {=max(1, round(users * weak / 100 * 0.1))} of them can see sensitive client files.
Nudge agent
Drafted a short message showing how to switch to an authenticator app in two minutes.
Policy
Proposed requiring a stronger method for sensitive spaces after a 30-day grace period.
followups: No. Users get reminders during the grace period, and anyone who hasn't switched gets a guided setup at their next sign-in.
Passwords alone are easy to phish or reuse. A second factor stops most account takeovers.
